text:
reena: opened a tiny PR to fix two things in the observability quickstart: inconsistent trace header examples (mix of `Trace-Id` and `x-rd-trace`) and a JS snippet using `oldCost` instead of `usage.tokens`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4102

omar: pinged. can you keep the examples minimal? customers copy the first thing they see.

reena: yup pared down the snippets to the minimal copy-paste examples, unified header to `x-rd-trace`, and added a 1-line compatibility note for SDKs <2.3.

docs-bot: linkcheck: 1 broken internal link in docs/observability/quickstart.md line 98 -> /sdk/telemetry/legacy (404). Suggested replacement: /sdk/migration/telemetry-2-3.

liam: i'll open a tiny site-config redirect after this merges. also left a tiny wording nit in the paragraph about cost numbers changing due to batching defaults. nothing blocking.

omar: LGTM modulo the linkfix. reena, squash and i'll merge after CI passes. :white_check_mark:

reena: squashed and pushed fixup. thanks all! :rocket:
